scope: All-exponent restricted common-cone projection lift; the eight-state host itself is frozen PR60 data. No unrestricted density claim.

mathematical_review.original_weights: Verified coarse relative kernels, full fine mu=pi/2, weighted composition and W row sum p. No conditional measure substituted.
mathematical_review.projection: Weighted rank-two Gram projection, H^2=beta Q, negative triangle, Q1 neither0 nor1, and original-law noncommutation all checked.
mathematical_review.cone_and_spectrum: Coarse eigenvalues and exact characteristic polynomial justify x,y; C spectrum is nonnegative, and fine whole-centered values x,y,beta,0 have multiplicities2,1,2,2.
mathematical_review.density_bound: Original-law sign expansion has exactly four triangles and three quadrilaterals. All-identity coarse term has density sum pi^-2=148 and weight y^N. Tuple3,1,1,1,1 has cycle exponents6,5,4,3,6,7,5.
mathematical_review.reflection_scope: All four claimed nonreflection tuples fail each of the three stated paired-vertex families; the boundary tuples remain separately labeled.
mathematical_review.count_scope: 55=5 projections times(10 generator triples+1 independent mixture). Eight specifications give seven distinct actual roots because zero channel and rank-zero projection coincide as roots. Fourteen specification/tuple checks give13 distinct root/tuple pairs.
mathematical_review.root_vs_square: The positive and negative signed-channel roots are distinct actual roots but have the same square. Counts are explicitly actual-root counts, not counts of distinct square kernels.
mathematical_review.degeneracies: Checked beta0, rank0, equality T=Pi, nonpositive channel eigenvalues via negative H, one coarse atom, weighted disconnected root, and connected bipartite root with disconnected square.
mathematical_review.arithmetic_module: Reviewed imported weighted mm/power/density/field/charpoly routines; guarded old main is never called and old boundary-only host checker is not imported.

limitation: Finite replay validates the finite data and implementations. General all-exponent validity rests on the separate reviewed common-cone proof.
